047        public void modifyFleet(SDMParams p, CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Random random, boolean withOverride) {
048                
049                Misc.addDefeatTrigger(fleet, "PK14thDefeated");
050                
051                fleet.setNoFactionInName(true);
052                fleet.setName("Remnants of Task Force Safeguard");
053                
054                AICoreOfficerPlugin plugin = Misc.getAICoreOfficerPlugin(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE);
055                
056                fleet.getFleetData().clear();
057                fleet.getFleetData().setShipNameRandom(random);
058                
059                
060                FleetMemberAPI member = fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember("legion_xiv_Automated");
061                //member.setShipName("HSS Sentinel");
062                member.setId("xivtf_" + random.nextLong());
063                PersonAPI person = plugin.createPerson(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE, fleet.getFaction().getId(), random);
064                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(true);
065                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.CARRIER_GROUP, 1);
066                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.FIGHTER_UPLINK, 1);
067                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(false);
068                
069                member.setCaptain(person);
070                ShipVariantAPI v = member.getVariant().clone();
071                v.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
072                v.addTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT);
073                v.addTag(Tags.TAG_AUTOMATED_NO_PENALTY);
074                member.setVariant(v, false, true);
075                fleet.setCommander(person);
076                
077                addAutomated(fleet, "onslaught_xiv_Elite", null, Commodities.ALPHA_CORE, random);
078                
079                addAutomated(fleet, "dominator_XIV_Elite", null, Commodities.BETA_CORE, random);
080                addAutomated(fleet, "eagle_xiv_Elite", null, Commodities.BETA_CORE, random);
081                addAutomated(fleet, "falcon_xiv_Elite", null, Commodities.BETA_CORE, random);
082                addAutomated(fleet, "falcon_xiv_Escort", null, Commodities.BETA_CORE, random);
083                
084                addAutomated(fleet, "enforcer_XIV_Elite", null, Commodities.GAMMA_CORE, random);
085                addAutomated(fleet, "enforcer_XIV_Elite", null, Commodities.GAMMA_CORE, random);
086                addAutomated(fleet, "enforcer_XIV_Elite", null, Commodities.GAMMA_CORE, random);
087
088                
089                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
090                        makeAICoreSkillsGoodForLowTech(curr, true);
091                        curr.getRepairTracker().setCR(curr.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR());
092                }
093                
094                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
095                        v = curr.getVariant().clone();
096                        v.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
097                        curr.setVariant(v, false, false);
098                }
099                
100                if (fleet.getInflater() instanceof DefaultFleetInflater) {
101                        DefaultFleetInflater dfi = (DefaultFleetInflater) fleet.getInflater();
102                        DefaultFleetInflaterParams dfip = (DefaultFleetInflaterParams)dfi.getParams();
103                        dfip.allWeapons = true;
104                        dfip.averageSMods = 3;
105                        dfip.quality = 0.4f;
106                        
107                        // what a HACK
108                        DModManager.assumeAllShipsAreAutomated = true;
109                        fleet.inflateIfNeeded();
110                        fleet.setInflater(null);
111                        DModManager.assumeAllShipsAreAutomated = false;
112                }
113                
114                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
115                        ShipVariantAPI var = member.getVariant().clone();
116                        var.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
117                        member.setVariant(var, false, true);
118                        
119                        curr.getVariant().addPermaMod(HullMods.AUTOMATED);
120                        curr.getVariant().setVariantDisplayName("Automated");
121                        curr.getVariant().addTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT);
122                        curr.getVariant().addTag(Tags.TAG_AUTOMATED_NO_PENALTY);
123                        curr.getVariant().addTag(Tags.VARIANT_UNRESTORABLE);
124                        curr.getVariant().addTag(Tags.TAG_RETAIN_SMODS_ON_RECOVERY);
125                        curr.getVariant().addTag(Tags.NO_DERELICT);
126                        if (curr.isCapital()) {
127                                curr.getVariant().addTag(Tags.VARIANT_ALWAYS_RECOVERABLE);
128                        }
129                }
130        }
131        
132        public static void addAutomated(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, String variantId, String shipName, String aiCore, Random random) {
133                AICoreOfficerPlugin plugin = Misc.getAICoreOfficerPlugin(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE);
134                
135                FleetMemberAPI member = fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(variantId);
136                member.setId("xivtf_" + random.nextLong());
137                
138                //System.out.println("ID for " + variantId + ": " + member.getId());
139                
140                //member.setId("xivtf_" + random.nextLong());
141                if (shipName != null) {
142                        member.setShipName(shipName);
143                }
144                if (aiCore != null) {
145                        PersonAPI person = plugin.createPerson(aiCore, fleet.getFaction().getId(), random);
146                        member.setCaptain(person);
147                }
148        }
149        
150        public static void makeAICoreSkillsGoodForLowTech(FleetMemberAPI member, boolean integrate) {
151                if (member.getCaptain() == null || !member.getCaptain().isAICore()) return;
152                
153                PersonAPI person = member.getCaptain();
154                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(true);
155                String aiCoreId = person.getAICoreId(); 
156                
157                if (integrate) {
158                        person.getStats().setLevel(person.getStats().getLevel() + 1);
159                        person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.BALLISTIC_MASTERY, 2);
160                }
161                
162                boolean alpha = Commodities.ALPHA_CORE.equals(aiCoreId);
163                boolean beta = Commodities.BETA_CORE.equals(aiCoreId);
164                boolean gamma = Commodities.GAMMA_CORE.equals(aiCoreId);
165                
166                if (member.isCapital() || member.isCruiser()) {
167                        person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.COMBAT_ENDURANCE, 0);
168                        person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.MISSILE_SPECIALIZATION, 2);
169                }
170                
171                // actually, the base skills are pretty much fine, so just add ballistic mastery if integrating, and
172                // that's all
173                
174                // Base skills, for reference (pulled from AICoreOfficerPluginImpl)
175                // ALPHA CORE
176//              person.getStats().setLevel(7);
177//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.HELMSMANSHIP, 2);
178//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.TARGET_ANALYSIS, 2);
179//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.IMPACT_MITIGATION, 2);
180//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.FIELD_MODULATION, 2);
181//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.GUNNERY_IMPLANTS, 2);
182//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.COMBAT_ENDURANCE, 2);
183//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.DAMAGE_CONTROL, 2);
184                
185                // BETA CORE
186//              person.getStats().setLevel(5);
187//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.HELMSMANSHIP, 2);
188//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.TARGET_ANALYSIS, 2);
189//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.IMPACT_MITIGATION, 2);
190//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.GUNNERY_IMPLANTS, 2);
191//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.COMBAT_ENDURANCE, 2);
192
193                // GAMMA CORE
194//              person.getStats().setLevel(3);
195//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.HELMSMANSHIP, 2);
196//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.IMPACT_MITIGATION, 2);
197//              person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.COMBAT_ENDURANCE, 2);
198                
199                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(false);
200        }
201        
202        @Override
203        public int getHandlingPriority(Object params) {
204                if (!(params instanceof SDMParams)) return 0;
205                SDMParams p = (SDMParams) params;
206                
207                if (p.entity != null && p.entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(
208                                MiscellaneousThemeGenerator.PK_CACHE_KEY)) {
209                        return 2;
210                }
211                return -1;
212        }
213        public float getQuality(SDMParams p, float quality, Random random, boolean withOverride) {
214                return quality;
215        }
